"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    arrays = [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]
    for arr in arrays:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Inputs must be np.ndarray")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2D")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError("Inputs cannot be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError("Inputs must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("Inputs must be nonpositive")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All inputs must have same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be bool")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")
    tau = float(tau_filter)
    # Compute average log probabilities over future horizon
    with_mean = np.mean(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    call_mean = np.mean(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    no_call_mean = np.mean(logp_no_call, axis=1)
    # Best baseline without result is the higher (better) mean log prob
    best_no_result = np.maximum(call_mean, no_call_mean)
    # Margin: how much better with_result is over best without result
    margin = with_mean - best_no_result
    # Keep if margin > tau (strict)
    keep = margin > tau
    return keep, margin
